一个老太太拉着你的袖子问：我儿子什么时候回来？: An old woman caught your sleeve and asked: when is my son coming home?
你说了谎。你当时还不知道。: You lied. You didn't know it yet.
要塞在河对岸。天还没亮，你听到那边有人在唱歌。: The fortress was across the river. Before dawn, you heard singing from the far bank.
是敌人的歌。你听不懂词，但调子和你们的一样。: It was the enemy's song. You couldn't follow the words, but the tune was the same as yours.
副官问：要开炮吗？: Your adjutant asked: shall we open fire?
歌声停了。然后你听到有人在哭。: The singing stopped. Then you heard someone crying.
你没让副官开炮。你也没让他停手。: You didn't order the guns. You didn't call them off either.
—— 半小时后，炮击开始了。: — Half an hour later, the bombardment began.
要塞拿下来了。旗子换了一面。: The fortress was taken. A different flag went up.
你走过战壕，看到两个士兵并排躺着 —— 一个你们的，一个他们的。: You walked the trench and saw two soldiers lying side by side — one of yours, one of theirs.
两个人的手都伸向同一个方向。: Both hands reached the same way.
你想知道那里有什么。你走过去，发现是一只掉落的水壶。: You wanted to know what was there. You walked over. It was a dropped canteen.
副官过来报告伤亡数字。你听不清。: The adjutant came with the casualty figures. You couldn't hear them.
你只记得动员令上那句话：圣诞节前就能回家。: All you could hear was the line from the order: home before Christmas.
地图上有它的名字，路牌已经没有了。: It still had a name on the map. The street signs were gone.
街角有一家面包店，橱窗碎了，里面还剩十几个面包。: A bakery on the corner, its window smashed, a dozen loaves still inside.
面包已经硬得咬不动。但没有人拿。: The bread was too hard to bite. Nobody took it.
有人在墙上用粉笔写了一个日期，和一句话：: Someone had chalked a date on the wall, and one line:
日期是三个月前。: The date was three months old.
城市还要往前打。: The city still has to be fought through.
下一个要塞在市区中心。侦察兵说里面还有平民。: The next fortress was downtown. Scouts said there were still civilians inside.
参谋摊开地图，用红笔圈出覆盖范围：: The staff officer spread the map and circled the coverage area in red:
「按标准程序，这里、这里、还有这里，都要炮火覆盖。」: "Standard procedure: here, here, and here all get artillery coverage."
你看着那片红色。红色的边界里有一所学校和一间医院。: You looked at the red. Inside the red were a school and a hospital.
你知道医院的位置 —— 上一场战斗里，你的伤员就是在那里救的。: You knew where the hospital was — your wounded had been treated there last battle.
参谋问：标准程序？: The staff officer asked: standard procedure?
多打两天，但医院不动。: Two more days, but the hospital stays standing.
清理队在做他们的事 —— 一具一具抬，一个一个登记。: The cleanup crews did their work — carrying them out one by one, registering them one by one.
有人在登记本上写：无名，男，约二十岁。: Someone wrote in the ledger: unidentified, male, approx. twenty.
同一个人，写了很多页。: The same person, for many pages.
你在一间被掀掉屋顶的房子里，看到黑板上还留着算术题。: In a roofless house, you saw arithmetic still on the blackboard.
下面有铅笔写的小字：我知道了，是 8。: Below it, in pencil: I know now. It's 8.
字迹很用力，笔尖把黑板划出了白痕。: Pressed hard enough that the chalk had scratched the board white.
你把门轻轻带上了。: You pulled the door gently shut.
新兵越来越年轻，老兵越来越少。: The recruits got younger. The veterans got fewer.
补给车已经两个月没有准时到过。: Supply trucks hadn't arrived on time in two months.
有人开始把家信叠成小方块，缝进衣领 —— 说是这样炮弹就打不中。: Some started folding letters into small squares and sewing them into their collars — said it stopped shells.
你知道这不灵。你没说。: You knew it didn't work. You said nothing.
夜里有人冻死了。早上点名的时候，排长会多喊一遍那个名字。: At night some froze to death. At morning roll call the sergeant would call that name once more.
然后沉默一会儿，喊下一个。: Then pause a moment, and call the next.
对面也是这么想的 —— 他们把所有的东西都堆在了这里。: The other side thought so too — they had piled everything in here.
情报说，那里的守军已经换过四批，最后一批连名字都没登记。: Intelligence said the garrison had been replaced four times. The last batch wasn't even registered.
你的副官 —— 从开战第一天就跟着你的那个 —— 昨天没回来。: Your adjutant — the one who'd been with you since day one — didn't come back yesterday.
他的位置现在站着一个十九岁的通讯兵。: A nineteen-year-old signaller stood in his place now.
通讯兵问：长官，打完这一仗是不是就结束了？: The signaller asked: sir, is it over after this one?
这一次，你想了想，没有骗他。: This time, you thought about it. You didn't lie.
活着的人只是坐在废墟上，谁也没有说话。: The survivors just sat on the rubble. Nobody spoke.
有人开始抽烟。有人开始翻口袋找家信。: Someone lit a cigarette. Someone else dug for letters.
有个兵忽然哭了起来，没人问为什么，也没人劝他。: A soldier suddenly began to cry. Nobody asked why. Nobody comforted him.
你走进要塞的指挥室。桌上摊着一张地图，: You walked into the command post. A map lay open on the table.
上面也画满了红色的圈，圈里也有学校、医院、还有墓地。: It was covered in red circles too. Inside them: schools, hospitals, and cemeteries.
两边的人，做的是同一件事。: Both sides had done the same thing.
后来你才知道，动员令上的那句话，: Later you learned that the line from the mobilization order —
部队征用了一家面包店做临时指挥所。: The unit requisitioned a bakery as a temporary command post.
老板站在门口，看着士兵把炉子拆掉搬走。他没有说话。: The owner stood in the doorway watching soldiers take the oven apart and carry it off. He said nothing.
后来你才知道，那炉子是他爷爷传下来的，: Later you learned the oven had come down from his grandfather.
用了六十年，烤过三代人的面包。: Sixty years old. It had baked bread for three generations.
他最后问了一句：炉子以后还能还给我吗？: At the end he asked one thing: will I get the oven back?
至少有个凭证。: At least there's a paper trail.
你在野战医院待了一夜。: You spent a night at the field hospital.
有个护士一直在换绷带，从傍晚换到天亮。: A nurse changed dressings all night, dusk to dawn.
她说她已经三天没睡了。: She said she hadn't slept in three days.
早上，一个伤员停止了呼吸。她按流程记录，盖上白布，: In the morning a patient stopped breathing. She logged it, drew the sheet over him,
然后走到下一个床边。: and moved to the next bed.
你问她：你记得住每一个人的脸吗？: You asked her: do you remember every face?
她说：记得住。所以才睡不着。: She said: yes. That's why I can't sleep.
你还有别的仗要打。: You have other battles to fight.
你走了。她还在换绷带。: You left. She was still changing dressings.
补充兵到了。有个孩子背着枪，比枪还矮一点。: Replacements arrived. One boy with a rifle was shorter than the rifle.
登记的时候，他说自己十九岁。: At registration he said he was nineteen.
手在抖，把出生年份写错了两次。: His hand shook. He got his birth year wrong twice.
你认出他是镇上中学的学生 —— 你见过他在车站卖报纸。: You recognized him — a student from the town secondary school. You'd seen him selling papers at the station.
你什么也没说，在登记表上签了字。: You said nothing and signed the form.
至少不用上前线。: At least he won't be at the front.
路上遇到一队逃难的人。: On the road you met a column of refugees.
一个母亲抱着孩子，孩子的鞋掉了一只。: A mother carrying a child. The child had lost one shoe.
她问：前面还有军队吗？: She asked: are there more soldiers ahead?
你不知道怎么回答。: You didn't know what to say.
她抱着孩子继续往前走了。孩子的另一只鞋在泥里，: She carried the child on. The other shoe lay in the mud.
清理战场的时候，有人翻出了一个敌人的钱包。: Clearing the field, someone turned up an enemy's wallet.
有一张照片：一个女人，两个孩子，背景是一间木头房子。: A photograph: a woman, two children, a wooden house behind them.
背面写着一行字，是他们的文字。: One line on the back, in their script.
「等我回来，我们去河边。」: "When I'm back, let's go to the river."
照片上的人笑得很开心。: The people in the photo were smiling.
有人问钱包怎么处理。: Someone asked what to do with the wallet.
问题是，没有人知道该寄到哪里。: The problem was nobody knew where.
把照片收进衣袋: Put the photo in your pocket
前线来了一批邮件。: A batch of mail reached the front.
大部分是家里寄来的 —— 毛衣、糖、还有晒干的烟叶。: Mostly from home — sweaters, sugar, dried tobacco leaf.
邮差说，也有往家里寄的，但是寄不出去。: The postman said there was outbound mail too, but it couldn't go out.
他把一叠信封放在桌上：这都是之前阵亡的战友写的。: He set a stack of envelopes on the table: these are from men who died.
他问：要不要帮忙送？: He asked: want me to deliver them?
但他已经送了 —— 他说他每个月都自己掏钱买邮票。: But he'd been delivering them anyway — buying the stamps himself every month.
至少这个能帮。: At least this you can do.
战壕里住着一只猫。: A cat lived in the trench.
没人知道它是从哪来的。可能是从城里跑出来的。: Nobody knew where it came from. Probably ran out of the city.
士兵们把自己那份罐头分一点给它。它不挑。: The men shared their tins with it. It wasn't picky.
它只在炮击的时候躲进洞里，其他时候就蹲在沙袋上晒太阳。: It only hid during shelling. The rest of the time it sat on the sandbags in the sun.
有个兵说：它比我们命大。: One soldier said: it's got more lives than us.
另一个说：不，它只是不在乎。: Another said: no. It just doesn't care.
后来有一天，炮击之后，猫没回来。: Then one day, after a shelling, the cat didn't come back.
有人在战壕外面找了很久。: Someone searched outside the trench for a long time.
浪费时间，但你还是去了。: A waste of time, but you went anyway.
战争里死掉的东西太多了。: Too many things die in a war.
一间被炸掉半边的教室。: A classroom with half its walls blown away.
黑板还挂在墙上。上面写着：: The blackboard still hung there. It read:
下面的课桌上，散着一叠作文本。: Below, a stack of exercise books scattered across the desks.
最上面那本，翻开着。上面只写了两行：: The top one lay open. Only two lines were written:
「我的理想是当老师。因为老师可以教别人。」: "My dream is to be a teacher. Because teachers can teach others."
「可是老师说，今年可能没有暑假了。」: "But teacher said there might be no summer holiday this year."
后面的字迹被雨水泡烂了。: The rest had been ruined by rain.
那一夜，对面的枪声停了。: That night the firing from the other side stopped.
战壕里的人都醒了。有人以为要进攻，端起了枪。: Everyone in the trench woke. Some thought it was an attack and raised their rifles.
然后对面传来声音 —— 有人在唱歌。: Then sound came across — someone singing.
过了一会儿，居然有人跟着哼起来，然后是笑。: After a while someone picked up the tune. Then came laughter.
两边的战壕里都有人在笑。笑得很累，但确实在笑。: There was laughter in both trenches. Tired laughter, but real.
二十分钟后，双方都恢复了原状。: Twenty minutes later, both sides went back to normal.
第二天早上，炮击照旧。: The next morning the shelling resumed as usual.
但你记得那二十分钟。: But you remembered those twenty minutes.
那时候没有人是敌人。: For that while, nobody was an enemy.
有些事不该进档案。: Some things don't belong in the files.
你收到一个任务：把阵亡者的身份牌收集起来。: You were given a job: collect the dog tags of the dead.
有个新兵跟着你做。他做得很快，一直到某一块牌子。: A new man worked alongside you. He was quick — until one tag.
他停下来，蹲在原地很久。: He stopped and crouched there a long time.
你走过去看。牌子上是他哥哥的名字。: You went over. The name was his brother's.
他早就知道哥哥阵亡了 —— 家里写过信。: He'd known his brother was dead — the family had written.
他说：我以为已经有人捡过了。: He said: I thought someone had already picked it up.
两个人都没有动。风很大。: Neither of you moved. The wind was strong.
这种时候，多半想一个人。: Times like this, a man wants to be alone.
你走开了，回头看见他还蹲着。: You walked away and looked back. He was still crouched.
炊事班找到一罐罐头，煮了一锅汤。: The cooks found one tin and made a pot of soup.
每人一勺，正好分完。: One ladle each. It came out exact.
最后轮到一个人，锅里没了。: When it reached the last man, the pot was empty.
炊事兵愣了一下，把自己那碗递过去。: The cook hesitated, then held out his own bowl.
对方摇头，说：你比我大。: The other shook his head: you're older than me.
两个人推来推去。最后谁也没喝，把碗放在了中间。: They pushed it back and forth. In the end neither drank. The bowl sat between them.
第二天，两个人都没醒来。: The next morning, neither of them woke.
汤还在那里，冻住了。: The soup was still there. Frozen.
田野里立着一个稻草人。: A scarecrow stood in the field.
它的衣服是军装的旧布，帽子是士兵的帽子。: Its clothes were scraps of uniform. Its hat was a soldier's cap.
显然是有人把自己的东西给了一个稻草人。: Someone had clearly given their own things to a scarecrow.
不知道为什么，没有一棵庄稼。: For some reason, there were no crops at all.
也许是因为种地的人都不在了。: Maybe because the people who farmed were gone.
也许是因为，给稻草人穿衣服的人，只是想证明: Maybe because whoever dressed the scarecrow only wanted to prove
这里曾经有人生活过。: that people had once lived here.
